coverage.note: lecturesTotal is the 9 recorded lectures in the Cairn catalog on 2026-10-21; the course site schedules 24, of which 1-9 had videos and slides. Lectures 1 (the introduction), 2 (discrete motion planning) and 3 (randomized motion planning with RRTs) are covered.

figureAudit.note: Lecture 1: six figure-heavy slides checked against the PDF by an independent reader, two small corrections; renders of slides 15 and 32 also checked. Lecture 2: seven slides (24, 33, 45, 56, 63, 73, 76) checked, all agreeing in substance, three small fixes; renders of slides 46 and 74 also checked. Lecture 3: two passes over 34 slides, including every step of the RRT worked example; the first pass found errors on 4 of its 10 pages (which point was in collision on slide 36, a node count, the extent of a tree), the second on 6 of 24 (mostly edges already drawn and small counts); all fixed. Renders of slides 36 and 50 also checked.

images.discovery: inline in wiki/ and raw/slides/; no index file
images.note: Lectures 1-3 only. Lecture 1: 24 of its 57 slides, every figure-bearing slide except title and divider slides, an unrendered video frame, news-headline screenshots, a decorative road sign, repeats, and photographs of course staff. Lecture 2: 22 of its 79 slides; build steps of the BFS, DFS and A* walk-throughs are represented by 41, 46, 59, 72 and 74, and pseudocode, text slides and repeats are not rendered. Lecture 3: 17 of its 62 slides; slides identical to ones already rendered for Lectures 1 and 2, steps of the RRT walk-through other than 25, 28, 32, 36, 43 and 47, text slides and repeated video frames are not rendered. No other lecture has images.

caveats: Covers lectures 1-3 of 9 recorded lectures; it cannot answer questions about the technical content of lectures 4 onward.
Transcripts are copy-edited from YouTube auto-captions; a few passages in each lecture were too garbled to restore and are marked [Ed: unclear]. The verbatim captions are not committed.
Lecture 1's deck has no slide 2 (hidden before export): slide N is PDF page N-1 from slide 3 on. Citations use the printed numbers.
Lecture 2's slide 73 says a tie in F is 'broken by smaller H', but both tied vertices have H = 6; the lecturer notices this in class (≈1:06:47). The slide file and wiki page say so.
Lecture 2's slides 62 and 76 are animations in the lecture; the PDF, and the image of slide 76, hold a single early frame.

Lecture 3's slides 49, 50, 58 and 59 are animations or videos; the PDF holds single frames (50 part-grown, 58 and 59 identical opening frames), so the wiki describes them as the lecture narrates them.
